answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose a new method to tackle the above challenges, aiming to obtain a high-quality pre-training model for dialogue generation.

answer_2.quote: In automatic evaluation, the following metrics are included: • BLEU ... • Distinct-1/2 ... • Knowledge Recall/Precision/F1 ... • In DSTC7-AVSD, ... using metrics of BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE-L and CIDEr.

answer_4.quote: In human evaluation, we randomly select 100 dialogue contexts and generate responses with compared methods. Three crowd-sourcing workers are asked to score the response quality on a scale of [0, 1, 2] from four aspects -fluency, coherence, informativeness and overall.
